an4.178:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:1.5: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ nappakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
an4.178:1.6: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:1.7: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso lasagatena hatthena sākhaṃ gaṇheyya tassa so hattho sajjeyyāpi gaṇheyyāpi bajjheyyāpi,
an4.178:1.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:1.10: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ nappakkhandati . . . na vimuccati,
an4.178:1.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pātikaṅkho. 2.
an4.178:2.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:2.3: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
an4.178:2.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:2.5: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso suddhena hatthena sākhaṃ gaṇheyya tassa so hattho n' eva sajjeyya na gaṇheyya na bajjheyya,
an4.178:2.6: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati . . .
an4.178:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:3.3: tassa avijjāpabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāpabhede cittaṃ nappakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati,
an4.178:3.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na avijjāpabhedo pātikaṅkho.
an4.178:3.6: tassā puriso yāni c' eva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya devo ca na sammādhāraṃ anupaveccheyya, evaṃ
an4.178:3.7: hi tassā bhikkhave jambāliyā na ālippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho,
an4.178:3.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:3.10: tassa avijjāpabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāpabhede cittaṃ nappakkhandati . . .
an4.178:3.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na avijjāpabhedo pāṭikaṅkho. 4.
an4.178:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:4.3: tassa avijjāpabhedaṃ manasīkaroto avijjāpabhede cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
an4.178:4.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjāpabhedo pātikaṅkho.
an4.178:4.6: tassā puriso yāni c' eva āyamukhāni tani vivareyya yāni apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya devo ca sammādhāraṃ anupaveccheyya, evaṃ
an4.178:4.7: hi tassā bhikkhave jambāliyā ālippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho,
an4.178:4.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:4.10: tassa avijjāpabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāpabhede cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati,
an4.178:4.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjāpabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
